name: @spec-cli/core
description: Composable specification framework for managing layered technical documentation
author: dean0x

skills.name: spec-authoring
skills.description: Guidance for authoring specifications following layer rules and component types

subcommands.name: add
subcommands.description: Create a new specification component from template

subcommands.name: remove
subcommands.description: Remove a feature and its owned components

agents.name: feature-composer
agents.description: Scaffolds new components using templates and updates indexes/manifests

agents.name: dependency-analyzer
agents.description: Builds and analyzes the specification dependency graph

agents.name: feature-remover
agents.description: Safely removes features with impact analysis and removal markers

agents.name: semantic-validator
agents.description: LLM-powered validation for contradictions, completeness, and terminology
